title: Subsequent Contravention
description: Extended prohibition period for subsequent contraventions

content.general_rule: The Central Authority may prohibit the endorser of a false or misleading advertisement from making endorsement of any product or service for a period which may extend to one year
content.exception: The Central Authority may prohibit such endorser from making endorsement in respect of any product or service for a period which may extend to three years for subsequent contraventions
